messages:
Alex Chen: Quick Q — Value Stack partner asked for a stacked reseller margin: base channel discount + onboarding rebate + a volume kicker. How should we present this without breaking deal desk constraints? Need to size margins for a new VAR.
Sara Patel: Do we have a template for 'stacking'? I've only seen flat % off list.
PricingBot: Rate card link: https://redwood.internal/pricing/value-stack (view-only). Standard max reseller margin = 25% for channel partners. Policy excerpt: 'no stacking beyond 25% unless Deal Desk approval is secured.'
Mike O'Connor: Customer scoped 18% base discount + 10% onboarding rebate + up to 8% volume kicker = potential 36% total concession. That's over the 25% cap. We should either convert some items to commit-backed concessions or reframe onboarding as post-adoption rebate.
Jordan Lee: If we convert onboarding to a one-time rebate (paid after POC / first 3 months), does that avoid the 'stacking' definition? @PricingBot?
PricingBot: Policy note: One-time rebates are still counted as economic concession and count toward the total 25% cap unless they're tied to a signed revenue commitment that justifies an exception.
Rebecca Gomez: From Deal Desk POV, propose these approvable structures:
  1) Reduce base discount to 12% and keep onboarding rebate at 10% -> total 22% (within cap).
  2) Keep partner's requested 18% base, but require a 12-month $COMMIT ARR minimum to qualify; submit for special approval.
  3) Offer a performance-based credit (up to 8%) paid quarterly based on usage milestones; requires SOW + legal + finance sign-off.
Alex Chen: Option 2 is what partner prefers. What docs do I need to submit for Deal Desk? :pray:
Rebecca Gomez: Submit: (a) completed partner MDR form, (b) proposed SOW, (c) revenue commit schedule, (d) partner margin calculation worksheet. Use the Deal Desk intake form: https://redwood.internal/dealdesk/submit and put 'Value Stack — Northstar VAR' in the subject, cc me.
Mike O'Connor: Also flag: reseller will handle downstream onboarding and may see customer PII during setup. I'll attach the security questionnaire answers to the ticket.
Jordan Lee: I'll draft commit language. Quick calc example for the worksheet:
```
Total_Concession_pct = base_discount_pct + onboarding_rebate_pct + expected_volume_credit_pct
Approved_if Total_Concession_pct <= 25% OR signed_commit_amount >= commit_threshold
```
Alex Chen: Great — I'll assemble the packet and submit today, tagging @Rebecca Gomez when it's uploaded. :thumbsup:
PricingBot: Reminder: any approval >25% requires Director of Sales + Revenue Ops sign-off. Typical Deal Desk turnaround: ~3 business days.
